message.content: {"count":4,"rationale":"Block codeRepo:collection, shareMount:collection, dbReplica:collection, and vaultRead:collection. These are all target parents, so four blocks suffice. For the lower bound, if appServer:lateralMovement remains reachable, codeRepo, dbReplica, and vaultRead must each be blocked; shareMount still has the configSecret → jumpHost path, requiring a fourth block. Thus any solution with at most three blocks must block appServer. The memoryDump → printServer → dbReplica path then requires one additional block on that path. None of those blocks affects serviceAccount → codeRepo or jumpHost → shareMount. No single remaining block can stop both: jumpHost has independent paths through configSecret and through ciRunner + sshKey → dbLogin, so a single block stopping shareMount must block jumpHost or shareMount itself, neither of which stops serviceAccount → codeRepo. Therefore three blocks cannot suffice."}
